title: Mind the Spread
briefing: Pebble Games trades thinly here: the gap between bid and ask is a full 1%. Scalper Sam trades it every day anyway.
objective: Every round trip pays the spread. In a wide-spread stock, trade less.
debrief: Pebble Games drifted gently higher, but every buy paid half of the 1% spread above the close and every sell paid half below it. Scalper Sam bought and sold most days, losing about 1% plus fees on each round trip. Players who bought once and held paid the spread only once, and their shares were valued at the final close.

basic.text: Make no more than 3 trades: each round trip pays the spread
